newsitem.title: DUBAI: UAE to set up oil drilling mud plant - paper.
newsitem.headline: UAE to set up oil drilling mud plant - paper.

text.p: Abu Dhabi-based oil service firm Hormuz International will build a 92 million dirham ($25 million) plant in the emirate to recycle oil drilling mud, the UAE Gulf News newspaper said on Thursday.
"At present drilling mud is buried in landfills or dumped in the sea. This is posing an environmental risk," a Hormuz International spokesman told the paper.
The plant, with an initial capacity of 50 tonnes a day, is expected to come on stream in the western industrial area of Ruwais in late 1997.
